name: Everlasting Nightmares
source:
It would seem that all is lost. Lena can no longer be brought back, and without her, Semyon sees no point in living. But despite this, the Camp won't let him die so easily. Will he be able to survive throughout all seven nightmares?

[spoiler]Continuation of Lena's Bad End.[/spoiler]
